rows.grounds: compound expressing manifested form; accusative singular neuter
compound of all, deity, and nature; accusative singular feminine

items.question: What alternative aspects of mantra are declared alongside all-deity nature?
premises: The verse lists alternatives with vā and ca.
It names expressed form and all-deity nature.
It closes with iti as quotation marker.
items.inference: The mantra is presented as either expressed form or all-deity nature.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic relation of cyarūpaṃ remains unclear.
The broader doctrinal referent of all-deity nature is not specified here.
items.plain_english: Or expressed form, and all-deity nature, thus.
